crossRefs.keyword: of the temple occupied an area of 100 square cubits

translations.web: So he measured the house, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;
translations.bsb: Then he measured the temple to be a hundred cubits long, and the temple courtyard and the building with its walls were also a hundred cubits long.
